title: AEC 102 - Agricultural Extension Education

items.q: Which term is described by “the timetable of activities with dates and responsibilities”?

baseline survey
calendar of work
work plan
items.s: work plan is the timetable of activities with dates and responsibilities.

divisibility
innovator
late majority
